title: Machine Learning Boosted Entropy-Engineered Synthesis of CuCo Nanometric Solid Solution Alloys for Near-100% Nitrate-to-Ammonia Selectivity.
summary: MLP-assisted parameter optimization supported synthesis of nanometric CuCo solid-solution alloys, followed by electrochemical selectivity and stability measurements. The abstract does not isolate every synthesis contribution.
organization: Jiangnan University; Key Laboratory of Synthetic and Biological Colloids, Ministry of Education; University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign

evidence.tested: MLP-assisted parameter optimization supported synthesis of nanometric CuCo solid-solution alloys, followed by electrochemical selectivity and stability measurements. The abstract does not isolate every synthesis contribution.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Multilayer perceptron with sample balancing is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
